title_en: Rules for the Implementation of the Law on Protection of Rights and Interests of Returned Overseas Chinese and Their Family Members of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en: Article 1 These Measures are formulated in accordance with the provisions of the Law of the People's Republic of China on the Protection of the Rights and Interests of Returned Overseas Chinese and the Family Members of Overseas Chinese.

Article 2 The identity of returned overseas Chinese and family members of overseas Chinese shall be examined and determined by the department responsible for overseas Chinese affairs under the local people's government at or above the county level in the place of their permanent residence, based on their application.
Where a relative who has a long-term foster relationship with an overseas Chinese or a returned overseas Chinese applies for the determination of the status of a family member of overseas Chinese, a notarized foster certificate shall be provided.

Article 3 After the death of an overseas Chinese or a returned overseas Chinese, or after a change in the status of an overseas Chinese, the status of their domestic family members as previously determined according to law shall remain unchanged.
Where the marital relationship is dissolved according to law with an overseas Chinese, a returned overseas Chinese, or their children, or where the foster relationship is dissolved according to law with an overseas Chinese or a returned overseas Chinese, the original status of family members of overseas Chinese that was determined according to law shall be lost.

Article 4 Local people's governments at all levels at or above the county level shall attach importance to and strengthen the protection of the legitimate rights and interests of returned overseas Chinese and family members of overseas Chinese.
The department responsible for overseas Chinese affairs under the people's government at or above the county level shall organize and coordinate relevant departments to properly protect the legitimate rights and interests of returned overseas Chinese and family members of overseas Chinese, and shall organize supervision and inspection of the implementation of laws and regulations on the protection of the rights and interests of returned overseas Chinese and family members of overseas Chinese within its administrative region.
The relevant departments under the people's government at or above the county level shall, within their respective functions and duties, properly protect the legitimate rights and interests of returned overseas Chinese and family members of overseas Chinese.

Article 5 Where an overseas Chinese requests to return to China for permanent residence, a certificate of return for permanent residence shall be issued in accordance with the state regulations on exit and entry administration.

Article 6 Local people's governments and relevant departments shall, in accordance with the relevant state provisions, arrange for the placement of overseas Chinese who return to China for permanent residence.

Article 7 The All-China Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese and local federations of returned overseas Chinese shall carry out activities in accordance with their articles of association and safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of returned overseas Chinese and family members of overseas Chinese.
Returned overseas Chinese and family members of overseas Chinese shall have the right to apply to establish other social organizations according to law and conduct lawful social activities that meet their needs.
The legitimate rights and interests of social organizations of returned overseas Chinese and family members of overseas Chinese, as well as their lawful activities conducted in accordance with their articles of association, shall be protected by law; no organization or individual may encroach upon or damage their lawfully owned property.

Article 8 The special funds allocated by people's governments at all levels to farms, forestry centers, and other enterprises for the placement of returned overseas Chinese shall be used for specific purposes only, and no organization or individual may misappropriate, withhold, or privately distribute them.
Local people's governments shall provide support to farms, forestry centers, and other enterprises for the placement of returned overseas Chinese.

Article 9 With respect to the land, mountain forests, beaches, water surfaces, and other resources lawfully used by farms, forestry centers, and other enterprises for the placement of returned overseas Chinese, the enterprises shall enjoy the right to use according to law, and no organization or individual may encroach upon or damage their means of production, crops under cultivation, or products produced; where the state lawfully expropriates or requisitions land of farms or forestry centers for the placement of returned overseas Chinese, compensation shall be given according to law.

Article 10 Schools and medical and health care institutions established in the places where farms, forestry centers, and other enterprises for the placement of returned overseas Chinese are located shall be incorporated into the education and health plans of the local people's government and subject to unified management.

Article 11 The State shall safeguard the social security rights and interests of returned overseas Chinese and family members of overseas Chinese according to law. Employers and returned overseas Chinese and family members of overseas Chinese shall participate in local social insurance according to law and pay social insurance premiums. Returned overseas Chinese and family members of overseas Chinese who participate in social insurance shall enjoy social insurance benefits according to law.
Local people's governments shall provide relief to returned overseas Chinese and family members of overseas Chinese who have genuine difficulties in living, and provide support to their production and employment; and shall guarantee the basic living of returned overseas Chinese and family members of overseas Chinese who have lost the ability to work and have no source of income according to law.

Article 12 Where returned overseas Chinese and family members of overseas Chinese invest in the development of barren mountains, barren land, or tidal flats according to law, or engage in agricultural, forestry, animal husbandry, or fishery production, the relevant local people's government shall provide support.

Article 13 Where returned overseas Chinese and family members of overseas Chinese establish public welfare undertakings within the country, people's governments at all levels and their relevant departments shall provide support, and their legitimate rights and interests shall be protected by law.
Where materials donated by overseas relatives of returned overseas Chinese and family members of overseas Chinese are used for public welfare undertakings within the country, customs duties and value-added tax on importation shall be reduced or exempted according to law.
Where property donated by enterprises invested in by returned overseas Chinese, family members of overseas Chinese, or their overseas relatives is used for public welfare undertakings, income tax preferences shall be enjoyed according to law.
Where overseas relatives of returned overseas Chinese and family members of overseas Chinese donate property to the country, the department responsible for overseas Chinese affairs under the people's government at or above the county level may assist in handling relevant entry procedures, provide assistance to the donor in implementing the donation project, and supervise the use and management of the donated property according to law.

Article 14 The State shall protect the ownership of private houses owned by returned overseas Chinese and family members of overseas Chinese within the country according to law. Returned overseas Chinese and family members of overseas Chinese shall enjoy the rights to possess, use, benefit from, and dispose of their private houses according to law, and no organization or individual may infringe upon such rights.

Article 15 Where a private house owned by a returned overseas Chinese or a family member of overseas Chinese is leased, the lessor and the lessee shall sign a lease contract and register it with the property management department at the location of the house. Upon termination of the lease contract, the lessee shall return the house to the lessor.

Article 16 Where a private house owned by a returned overseas Chinese or a family member of overseas Chinese is lawfully demolished, the demolition party shall provide monetary compensation or implement property right exchange in accordance with the state regulations on the administration of house demolition. Where a private house owned by a returned overseas Chinese or a family member of overseas Chinese that is leased at the rent standard set by the government is demolished, the measures for compensation and resettlement shall be prescribed by the competent department of construction under the State Council jointly with relevant departments.

Article 17 Where children of overseas Chinese return to China to attend schools that implement compulsory education, they shall be treated as children of local residents for enrollment procedures; where returned overseas Chinese students, children of returned overseas Chinese, and children of overseas Chinese within the country apply for admission to schools of non-compulsory education run by the State, the education and other relevant departments shall, in accordance with the relevant state provisions and in light of the actual local conditions, give them preferential treatment.

Article 18 Overseas remittances are the lawful income of returned overseas Chinese and family members of overseas Chinese, and their ownership shall be protected by law. No organization or individual may embezzle, delay payment, force loans, or illegally freeze or confiscate them.

Article 19 Where returned overseas Chinese and family members of overseas Chinese need to go abroad to dispose of property or accept inheritance, legacy, or donation, the relevant departments and China's diplomatic (consular) missions abroad or other overseas missions authorized by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs may, upon the request of the returned overseas Chinese or family members of overseas Chinese, provide necessary assistance.

Article 20 The freedom and secrecy of correspondence of returned overseas Chinese and family members of overseas Chinese shall be protected by law. No organization or individual may unlawfully open, conceal, destroy, or steal their mail. Where registered mail of returned overseas Chinese or family members of overseas Chinese is lost, damaged, or short of contents, the postal department shall compensate according to law.

Article 21 Where returned overseas Chinese or family members of overseas Chinese apply for exit, the relevant competent department shall handle the procedures according to law within the prescribed time limit.
Where returned overseas Chinese or family members of overseas Chinese need to exit urgently due to special circumstances such as a critical illness or death of a direct relative abroad, or handling of property abroad, the relevant competent department shall, based on the valid certificates provided by the applicant, handle the matter on a priority basis.
Article 22 Returned overseas Chinese and family members of overseas Chinese shall enjoy the treatment of exit for visiting relatives in accordance with the relevant state provisions on family visits.

Article 23 Where returned overseas Chinese and family members of overseas Chinese who have retired (or resigned from active service) according to state regulations are approved to settle abroad, the retirement (or resignation) benefits they enjoy according to state regulations shall remain unchanged. Their pension may be collected by an authorized person, but they shall provide, each year, a certificate of their own survival issued by China's diplomatic (consular) mission in the country of their residence or by a notarial institution of that country to the original work unit or the social insurance agency responsible for paying the pension.
Where returned overseas Chinese and family members of overseas Chinese, after retirement (or resignation) and settlement abroad, return to China for medical treatment, they shall enjoy corresponding medical benefits in accordance with the relevant local provisions.
Where returned overseas Chinese and family members of overseas Chinese who do not meet the retirement conditions stipulated by the state are approved to settle abroad, they shall go through the procedures for resignation, dismissal, or termination of labor relations in accordance with the relevant state provisions, and enjoy a one-time severance pay and related benefits in accordance with the relevant state provisions; if they have already participated in basic endowment insurance and basic medical insurance, the social insurance agency shall settle in a lump sum the expenses attributable to them in accordance with the relevant state provisions, and terminate their basic endowment insurance and basic medical insurance relations.
Where returned overseas Chinese and family members of overseas Chinese, after being approved to settle abroad, have participated in other social insurance outside the provisions of the preceding paragraph before exit, they shall enjoy corresponding social insurance benefits in accordance with the relevant state provisions.

Article 24 Before returned overseas Chinese and family members of overseas Chinese obtain an entry visa to the country (region) of destination, their work unit or school shall not dismiss them, discharge them, terminate labor relations, stop paying wages, or order them to withdraw from school on account of their application for exit, nor shall they collect any deposit or mortgage.
Where returned overseas Chinese and family members of overseas Chinese are approved to exit for family visits in accordance with the relevant state provisions on family visits, their jobs and rented public housing shall be retained during the approved leave period.

Article 25 Where returned overseas Chinese and family members of overseas Chinese exit for family visits or settlement, they may exchange foreign exchange in accordance with the regulations; where they settle abroad, the social insurance benefits and housing provident fund they receive may be exchanged for foreign exchange and remitted or taken abroad in accordance with the regulations.

Article 26 China's diplomatic (consular) missions abroad shall, in accordance with the international treaties concluded or acceded to by China or international practice, protect the legitimate rights and interests of returned overseas Chinese and family members of overseas Chinese abroad.
Where returned overseas Chinese and family members of overseas Chinese abroad have pensions, pensions of disabled or deceased persons, or other benefits to be collected, China's diplomatic (consular) missions abroad may, upon their request, provide necessary assistance.

Article 27 Where the legitimate rights and interests of returned overseas Chinese and family members of overseas Chinese are infringed upon, they shall have the right to request the relevant competent department to handle the matter according to law, or to file a lawsuit with the People's Court. For returned overseas Chinese and family members of overseas Chinese who have economic difficulties, the local legal aid institution shall provide them with legal aid according to law. Federations of returned overseas Chinese at all levels shall provide support and assistance.

Article 28 Where any institution or personnel handling special overseas Chinese affairs funds, in violation of these Measures, misappropriates, withholds, or privately distributes special overseas Chinese affairs funds, the directly responsible person in charge and other directly liable persons shall be given administrative sanctions or disciplinary sanctions according to law; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law. The misappropriated, withheld, or privately distributed special overseas Chinese affairs funds shall be ordered by the competent department to be recovered.

Article 29 Where any functionary of a state organ abuses his or her power, neglects his or her duty, or engages in malpractice for personal gain, thereby causing damage to the legitimate rights and interests of returned overseas Chinese and family members of overseas Chinese, the directly responsible person in charge and other directly liable persons shall be given administrative sanctions or disciplinary sanctions according to law; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Article 30 These Measures shall come into force as of July 1, 2004. The Implementing Measures of the Law of the People's Republic of China on the Protection of the Rights and Interests of Returned Overseas Chinese and the Family Members of Overseas Chinese, promulgated by the State Council on July 19, 1993, shall be abolished simultaneously.
